description:
TPO 156 G1 Lebanon and Plum to reduce height by 1m and lateral spread up to 0.5m. 

Conservation
To reduce height by up to 3m and lateral spread on 20x Leyland Cypress situated on boundary between 19 Uplands Court & Frithwood Nursing Home. To prune lower lateral spread by removing 2m on 1x Oak situated in car park right hand boundary all located within Uplands Court, 19 Frithwood Avenue.  

Tree Number - G1
Tree Type - Approx 20x Leyland Cypress (Cupressus leylandii) 
Approx. Diameter at 1.5m - 0.4m
Approx. Height - 6m
Approx. Width - 1m
Approx. Length - 25m
Location - On boundary between 19 Uplands Court and Frithwood Nursing Home
Service - Crown Reduction
Work Required - Reduce height by up to 3m to give a finishing height of approximately 3m, Prune/trim lateral growth on clients side and Frithwood Road to form a compact hedgerow.
Reason - To reduce encroachment over parking spaces and to reduce wind sail effect
Priority Code - ON

Tree number - T1
Tree type - Red Oak (Quercus rubra)
Approx Height - 14m
Location - Within car park, right hand boundary
Service - Prune
Work required- Prune lower lateral protruding towards G1 by removing approximately 2m
Reason - To tidy shape of crown
Priority code - ON
